subject: re-st
title: (R)RE.ST.------AF.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 277 (PR.S(RD)II-31). RE-ST (restructuralism) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; AF-DY (affinity dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: VT-PLAT, TR-INFO (trans-information) and SOC-RT (social reality). From VT-PLAT: MOT-DY. From MOT-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From TR-INFO: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From PROJ-DY: BIA (bi-aitional). From SOC-RT: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). The text above the chart says: "The reality of affinity dynamics is directly related to the multi-use of redefinitions."
